title: E256-H H4 per-round switching-sequence census, collapse, integrated RTL, and mapped-cost gate

architecture_contract.digest_rule: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes from the first byte of the unique start marker through the last byte of the unique end marker, inclusive

toolchain.scope: Yosys/ABC-mapped generic RTL and Icarus-validated behavior in the HELUT repository; no vendor P&R or implicit Metal execution

questions.text: Does every contiguous three-round window in the complete frozen arithmetic schedule family satisfy the byte all-to-all dependency criterion when each round uses its actual selector?
Does the sequence-specific H3 offset collapse agree at every frozen round boundary with the independent canonical evaluator?
Do commit-sampled repeated and per-round sequence selectors execute byte-exactly with complete ready/busy evidence in stationary-FF and rotating-ring integrated tops?
What paired generic-LUT6, sequential-state, primitive-cell, and end-to-end depth delta does 144-bit sequence selection introduce over 12-bit repeated selection within each storage organization?

record_schema.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, separators ',' and ':', allow_nan false

executable.scope_limit: Executable coverage is balanced by tuple and round position but is not exhaustive over transition pairs or orbit lengths

material_corpus.source: the exact three material sets and eight blocks used by the frozen H2/collapse predecessors

collapse_contract.interior: K_r = L_(w_(r-1))(B_(r-1)) XOR M_r XOR A_r for 1 <= r < 12

structural_contract.criterion: For every contiguous three-round window, initialize each input byte with its own dependency singleton, treat S-box as lane-preserving, apply exact per-round AES row mixing and certified row-offset selector, and require every output byte to depend on all 32 input bytes
structural_contract.failure_reporting: report complete failure count and first deterministic counterexample without filtering
structural_contract.explicit_exclusion: The fixed-tuple/local 25-active-S-box four-round statement is not inherited or asserted for mixed sequences

sequence_interface.repeated_behavior: retain low 12 bits and reuse w_0 for all rounds
sequence_interface.sequence_behavior: retain all 144 bits and select w_r by public round_index
sequence_interface.restart_behavior: every accepted block restarts at w_0
sequence_interface.post_commit_pin_rule: external changes have no effect until another complete successful commit

protocol_contract.configuration: clean idle cfg_begin, thirteen accepted effective-mask word beats, then clean idle cfg_commit
protocol_contract.stimulus_rule: one block starts only while ready; the next start is attempted at the earliest ready edge after done
protocol_contract.round_edges: E1 through E12 execute rounds 0 through 11 with K_1 through K_12
protocol_contract.error_rule: incomplete, overlapping, or busy-time configuration is rejected without changing committed in-flight state

accounting: recursive child multiplicity closes against independent flat primitive multiset
mask and selector state are counted separately
wide live ports may not externalize committed mask or selector state
analysis-only flatten preserves mapped primitive counts
flattened end-to-end combinational depth is loop-free
synthesis_contract.comparison_rule: sequence minus repeated within the same storage_id only; no winner threshold

controls.mutation: change one generated schedule index before digest validation
use w_(11-r) in the sequence evaluator
use w_0 for every switching round
transport B_(r-1) with w_r rather than w_(r-1)
add an unauthorized terminal A_12 term
use K_r where K_(r+1) is required
reverse the 32 byte lanes in each configured mask word
omit the acceptance rotation that advances K_0 to K_1
commit after twelve mask words and attempt start
read live cfg_h4_sequence pins after a successful commit
replace committed selector state with a wide live input
replace the integrated 3328-bit mask store with wide live inputs
evaluate a known hierarchy with repeated nested children
count one planted child edge twice
corrupt the expected primitive/depth relation across analysis-only flatten
inject one d=1 output for a repeated variant
remove one latency/initiation observation from an otherwise valid row

predictions.statement: all frozen source, tool, corpus, execution-set, semantic, cycle, synthesis, and control invariants close exactly
the complete arithmetic census may have zero or nonzero mixed-window dependency failures; neither outcome invalidates the harness
sequence selection has measurable paired mapped deltas; no sign, magnitude, or storage winner is predicted

receipt_contract.deterministic_digest_rule: SHA-256 of canonical compact sorted-key JSON encoding of deterministic_payload
receipt_contract.record_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical compact sorted-key JSON encoding of the complete record with record_sha256 set to null
receipt_contract.check_rule: --check regenerates and requires byte-identical deterministic_payload and deterministic_payload_sha256, exact current source/prereg identities, and all validity predicates

validity_rule: Exact identities and counts, all nineteen controls detected, complete collapse and RTL/model agreement, per-input cycle evidence, and closed synthesis/accounting are mandatory. Structural counterexamples and any mapped-cost delta sign remain valid reportable science.
non_claims: no H4 production policy or architecture selection
no inherited mixed-sequence 25-active-S-box or four-round bound
no cryptographic security level or primitive selection
no XOF, schedule, round-count, cipher-suite, or AEAD selection
no vendor FPGA, place-and-route, Fmax, physical power, or literal GPU-to-FPGA synthesis evidence
no encrypted Metal or FHE execution claim
E256-063 remains OPEN and no C/H/N or public claim epoch moves
